subject: Home Electrification Training and Sustainability Outreach
overview: The council discussed administrative schedule changes and coordinated outreach for several upcoming community events. Staff also provided a technical training session on home electrification technologies including heat pumps, solar arrays, and electric vehicles.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The council approved the minutes from the previous meeting with a correction regarding activity suggestions.

items.title: Meeting Schedule Change
items.summary: Future meetings were moved to Mondays at 6:00 PM starting October 21st to accommodate staff availability.

items.title: Personnel Update
items.summary: Staff announced the hiring of Jackie Forcino as the new head clerk in the Planning, Development, and Sustainability Department.

items.title: Event Planning and Debrief
items.summary: The council debriefed a successful electric vehicle showcase and coordinated participation in upcoming Hispanic Heritage Month events, Tufts Community Day, and the Harvest Your Energy Festival.

items.title: Curbside Composting Pilot
items.summary: The group discussed a pilot program for the automatic distribution of composting bins to residents and potential outreach strategies for the Mystic Market.

items.title: City Infrastructure and Legislative Updates
items.summary: Updates were provided on school decarbonization projects, the status of an EV charging revolving fund ordinance, and a large-scale solar project at the Great American Beer Hall.

items.title: Electrify Medford and Greenhouse Gas Reporting
items.summary: Staff reported that 65 residents have registered for energy coaching and provided a status update on the city's annual greenhouse gas and green community reports.

items.title: Home Electrification Training
items.summary: Staff conducted a training presentation for members on heat pump water heaters, solar thermal systems, induction cooking, and electric vehicle charging logistics.

items.title: Proposed Tree Ordinances
items.summary: The council reviewed the status of three pending tree ordinances and planned a future discussion with the Tree Warden.
